summary: Slot-indexed conditional delegator. Loads the element pointer at this dword index a2+2, returns -1 when it is null, forwards a3..a7 to sub_55BD20, returns -1 when that sub-call fails, otherwise records the slot index a2 back into this[0] and returns the sub-call result.

local_names.a2: slot index selecting the element at this dword index a2+2

operations.description: Load the element pointer v8 = *(int**)(this + 4*(a2+2)) from the slot array indexed by a2.
If v8 is null, return -1 immediately without calling sub_55BD20.
Call sub_55BD20(v8, a3, a4, a5, a6, a7) and keep its return value.
If sub_55BD20 returned non-zero, return -1 on the failure path.
Store the slot index back into the first dword: this[0] (byte offset 0x0) = a2.
Return the sub-call result (0 on the success path).

clean_pseudocode: result = sub_55BD20(element, a3, a4, a5, a6, a7);
